goals.title: Step 1: Omit tools on JSON-required seats (fixes critic Groq 400)
goals.description: In src/swarm/agent.ts Agent.run and src/swarm/engine/seatToolLoop.ts runSeatWithTools, if seat must return strict JSON (critic / risk / risk_critic, or runConfig has responseMimeType application/json or zodSchema), do not attach tools or expand toolRegistry, and do not default toolChoice to auto.
goals.verificationCriteria: A critic/JSON seat request body has no tools array and cannot call a tool named 'json'.

goals.title: Step 2: Run analyst tools per slate game within existing caps
goals.description: In src/swarm/engine/analystExecution.ts and seatToolLoop, iterate parsedHeaders games in header order, bounded by existing seatBudget(provider) caps (maxToolCalls 6/8, maxToolResultChars 2000/6000, maxPromptChars 5600, renderHeaders 1600). Record coveredEventIds.
goals.verificationCriteria: A multi-game slate invokes tools for each game until budget cap, recording coveredEventIds.

goals.title: Step 3: Tell proposer covered event ids and drop uncovered picks
goals.description: In lifecycle executeAndVerify, executeManagerSynthesis, executeScorecardSynthesis, pass coveredEventIds to proposer, and drop any pick whose event_id or mapped R-id is not in coveredEventIds.
goals.verificationCriteria: Picks for uncovered event IDs or R-ids are dropped; uncovered-only results in no picks.

goals.title: Step 4: Tests for JSON seats, per-game tools, and uncovered pick dropping
goals.description: Add tests asserting: (a) critic/JSON seat outbound request has no tools; (b) 3-game parsedHeaders calls tools per game until maxToolCalls; (c) proposer/manager/scorecard picks on uncovered games are dropped; update getRoleToolNames tests if needed.
goals.verificationCriteria: All new and touched tests pass cleanly.

goals.title: Step 5: Full verification, push branch, and open PR
goals.description: Node 22 strip-only check, vitest on touched and full suite, tsc --noEmit, smoke-start, push fix/critic-analyst-scope to origin, open PR on GitHub with mandatory text.
goals.verificationCriteria: Full test and build verification clean; PR opened on GitHub with required body.
